note: Knife attack pose timeline (read by PixelWeaponArt through MeleeArt_ProtoKnife.asset into the view profile). Same values as the reviewed preview (Tools/pixelart/make_knife_pose_guide.py TIMELINE / POSES, docs/review/player-parts/knife/slash/finishing/README.md). The phases come from the weapon (Melee_ProtoKnife: windup 0.12 s, active 0.12 s, recovery 0.28 s); from / to are phase progress. pose: 0 = pose 1 windup, 1 = pose 2 centre pass, 2 = pose 3 follow-through, -1 = the rest image. grip / offsets: view units at z = 1 for 16:9 before the right-edge follow (screen half height = tan 25 deg); relativeToRest = offsets from the rest grip. roll in degrees. easeOut: active window fast start / slowing; otherwise smooth in / out. narrowLayout: on screens narrower than 16:9 the whole path's x is pulled toward centreX, by scaleAt4x3 at 4:3 (preview example values, checked on iPhone 16 Pro / 16:9 / 4:3). Presentation only: damage, range and timing are not here. Written by hand.
